zones.name: The Ashen Reach
zones.description: A grey land where the Emberwyrm's fire fell long ago; trolls hunt the ash and the deathless keep their vigil.

zones.name: Briarwatch Wood
zones.description: The young forest north of Thornwood, watched over by the briar-wardens and thick with wolves and spiders.

zones.name: The Cinderdeep Mines
zones.description: Ogre-dug tunnels into a seam of living fire, worked by slaves and watched by the Cinder Foreman.

zones.name: The Cinderspire Wastes
zones.description: Black glass and smoking vents beneath the Cinderspire, where fire imps dance and obsidian walks.

zones.name: Cragfoot Hills
zones.description: Wind-scoured hills below Cragmouth's gate, where goats graze and cave beetles burrow.

zones.name: Cragmouth
zones.description: A fortress-city carved into a mountain's jaw, its stone halls warmed by forges that never cool.

zones.name: The Deathless Sanctum
zones.description: The hidden temple of the Deathless, where the faithful give up their mortality one ritual at a time.

zones.name: Duskmere Shore
zones.description: The long grey shore of the Duskmere, where ferries land and the old lighthouse keeps a lonely watch.

zones.name: The Emberglade
zones.description: Rolling meadows east of Emberhold, where ember rats nest in the warm earth and brigands watch the road.

zones.name: Emberhold
zones.description: A walled river city built around the Great Forge, whose fire has not gone out in four hundred years.

zones.name: The Emberwyrm's Lair
zones.description: The burning heart of the Stormcrown, where the Emberwyrm sleeps on the hoard of a thousand years.

zones.name: Frostveil Tundra
zones.description: A white waste of ice and wind where the frost wraiths sing and crystals grow from the snow.

zones.name: Gloomfen Bog
zones.description: A sour black bog where the drowned do not rest and things with too many eyes wait beneath the water.

zones.name: The Gloomroot Caverns
zones.description: Warm caves under the ice where roots as thick as towers feed on something old.

zones.name: The Hollowmere Crypts
zones.description: The sunken abbey of Hollowmere, whose monks swore to serve beyond death and kept their word.

zones.name: Hollowpine Forest
zones.description: A dark pine forest whose trees grow hollow with age, where wolves run in packs and treants stir.

zones.name: Mirefang Hollow
zones.description: A drowned cave under the fens where the mirefolk feed their god, a serpent grown huge on offerings.

zones.name: The Obsidian Citadel
zones.description: A fortress of black glass raised by the Obsidian Tyrant. A raid of many is needed to breach it.

zones.name: The Proving Flats
zones.description: A wide test plain ringed by camps of rising danger: level 1 near the centre, level 60 at the edges. A test and development zone: not reachable by zone lines.

zones.name: Rattlebone Warren
zones.description: Burrows and bone-pits under the Emberglade, where the restless dead of an old battlefield gather.

zones.name: The Redrock Badlands
zones.description: Sun-baked mesas of red stone, home to ogre clans and the mines they have taken for their own.

zones.name: The Saltmarsh Fens
zones.description: Tidal fens where the three roads meet: reed-adders in the shallows and a drowned watchtower on every rise.

zones.name: The Shattered Steppe
zones.description: Endless grass broken by the ruins of a fallen empire, roamed by drakes and the cultists who serve them.

zones.name: The Stormcrown Peaks
zones.description: The roof of the world, where lightning never stops and the wyrms' children nest above the clouds.

zones.name: The Stormspire Ruins
zones.description: The broken tower of a fallen empire's storm-mages, reclaimed by cultists who would call the lightning back.

zones.name: The Sunken Bastion
zones.description: A sea fort the Duskmere swallowed whole. Its drowned garrison still keeps the watch.

zones.name: Thornwood
zones.description: Halls woven from living briar beneath the Heartwood, the oldest tree in the realm, ringed by its ancient daughters.
